notes.title: Piece Yourself Up - Build 2.05
notes.content:
Introducing Achievements! 

Achievements can now be earned for
- Completing a day with no spoons
- Holding 12 spoons at one time
- Completing the first day
- Reaching day five
- Reaching day ten
- Reaching day fifteen 
- Reaching day twenty

Good luck completing them all!
